rounded_corners.cause: A container with a radius clips its children in the draft (overflow hidden/clip); the live equivalent keeps overflow visible (the sgs/container default), so a square child or a latent hover/zoom layer can paint past the rounded corners. No hand step reads the draft overflow, and the parity walker has no overflow row.

coverage.token_note: radius equals a handoff token (--radius-tile 12, --radius-card 22, --radius-panel 12, --radius-pill 999) for by_token_or_surfaces instances; overflow has no token or surfaces.json record, only the draft computed value through the pair
coverage.pipeline_function_already_mapping: scripts/computed-route/lib/db.mjs (overflow-x/overflow-y reach the container `overflow` setting through the shorthand family) and lib/fill-resolve-state.mjs::BOX_PAINT (lists overflow) can write it from a pair; nothing triggers it for a resting overflow difference

future_clone.why: The resolver can map a draft overflow to sgs/container overflow, but Fill writes only what a walker row asks for and scripts/parity/lib/compare.mjs compares no overflow property (scripts/parity/lib/collect.mjs::collectPair reads overflow only as a passThrough paints flag). On Indus every clip that exists was hand-set in rounds (fix-catalogue R2-02, R3-02, R5-08).

pinned_sticky.cause: The draft pins a column with position: sticky and a top (120px, 110px on Apply, 84px for the timeline track, 0 for the header); the clone wrote position: sticky from the width ladder without the top (so it never pins), or no sticky at all.

coverage.animations_note: header: surfaces.json S-03 and animations.json J-01 (header scroll shadow) name the sticky header; the timeline pin is J-04 to J-08; the column pins have no record, their top is only in the draft computed value
coverage.pipeline_function_already_mapping: scripts/computed-route/lib/motion-behaviour-settings.mjs::stickyTiers (header only); scripts/computed-route/lib/fill-width-ladder.mjs rung 4 (writes the sticky Custom CSS without the top); scripts/computed-route/lib/fill-declared.mjs::unreadDeclared (reads a sticky top only when declared, then it is not written)

future_clone.why: The header pin is carried (motion-behaviour-settings.mjs::stickyTiers). Column pins go through fill-width-ladder.mjs rung 4 as scoped Custom CSS with no top, and no code in scripts/computed-route/lib writes the container pinEdge / pinGap / pinBelowHeader settings (grep: 0 hits); the walker compares no position row, so a pin that never pins is invisible.

layout_widths.cause: Paired layout containers (max-width bands, grids) whose resolved width, left edge, max-width or column count differ from the draft: a side gutter that measures 27px at 375 where the draft is 20px (and 46px against 32px at 768), grids declared auto-fit in the draft but written as fixed 4/2/1 tiers live, text blocks narrower than the draft, and structural differences (timeline track, 2-column rows).

coverage.token_note: the gutter tokens (20/32/40) reached the snapshot and match the draft band padding; the live inset differs for another reason not isolated here
coverage.pipeline_function_already_mapping: scripts/computed-route/lib/fill-width-ladder.mjs and lib/fill-dimensions.mjs write widths and max-widths from the draft computed values at 375/768/1440/1920

future_clone.why: The width ladder reads the draft computed values at four widths for every pair, so bands and max-widths mostly land (examined vs differing above); what it does not read is the draft declared auto-fit/auto-fill (the live grids carry fixed repeat(4/2/1) tiers) nor widths between the four read widths, so a future clone repeats the grid fill-mode difference.
